architectural_notes: Implement role-based access control: admins can manage/administer other users' roles (including granting admin), not restricted to owner-only.

existing_features.title: Update the Admin Access Management UI copy so it no longer claims the feature is owner-only, and reflects that any admin can grant/revoke admin access.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update permissions so any admin (not just the owner) can grant admin access to other users
Update backend admin-access authorization so any caller who is an admin can grant admin access to another user (by email), instead of restricting this action to only the owner.
Update backend admin-access authorization so any caller who is an admin can revoke admin access (by email), instead of restricting this action to only the owner.

projectName: Allow any admin (not just owner) to grant admin access
